visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a bright teal and blue digital billboard advertising a 'POP UP STORE' for 'The First Frost' (难哄), featuring artwork of a male and female character at a desk. Pink and white variety-style text overlays the bottom of the frame. (2) The camera transitions to a medium handheld shot of a woman with long brownish hair, wearing glasses and a black t-shirt, walking next to a man in a black cap and t-shirt; they are outdoors under a checkered black-and-white umbrella. (3) The scene shifts to the entrance of 'Shin Kong Mitsukoshi' department store, then cuts to a large, life-size wall poster of the drama's main couple in a romantic embrace. (4) Inside the exhibition, the woman walks past various walls decorated with photos from the show and large Chinese text. The lighting is bright and even studio-style. (5) A man in a baseball cap (Mr. Joe) speaks directly to the camera while standing next to the woman; he then poses next to a cardboard cutout of the female lead character. (6) A montage shows various themed areas: a photo wall of small screenshots, a realistic prop of a pink strawberry birthday cake with a smiley face sitting on a wooden table, and a recreated noodle shop scene with green tiled walls and wooden furniture. (7) The woman is seen sitting at the noodle shop table, holding chopsticks and posing with two bowls. (8) Close-up shots of props include a circular acrylic display showing '1587 Overtime' and two mannequins wearing school-style tracksuits. (9) A wall-mounted flat-screen TV is shown playing behind-the-scenes clips of the actors on a filming set. (10) Further details include a chalkboard filled with white chalk handwriting inside a heart shape, and a glass display case containing a bottle of perfume, a jewelry box, and a bracelet. (11) The final segment shows the woman in a crowded merchandise area, holding a shopping basket and then displaying several printed postcards/photo cards of the male lead to the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy lifestyle vlog and promotional showcase for a 'The First Frost' pop-up store exhibition. It aims to share the creator's enthusiastic experience at the venue, highlighting the romantic atmosphere, screen-accurate sets, exclusive behind-the-scenes content, and available merchandise to encourage fellow fans to visit.
